# Horizon Vantage
> Horizon Vantage is a one-person photography, videography, web design and local SEO business based in Co. Wicklow, Ireland. It makes real on-site photos and video for local businesses - cafés, bakeries, barbershops, pet shops and other shops, holiday lets, glamping, B&Bs, activity providers and artisan food and drink producers - builds a fast custom website around them, and sets up the Google Business Profile so all three match. Founder: Gelmis Bartulis.

## Quick facts
- Business: Horizon Vantage (sole trader, registered with the Companies Registration Office, Ireland, number SR9692490)
- Based in: Co. Wicklow, Ireland. Works across Wicklow, Kildare, Wexford and Dublin, and further afield across Ireland
- Services: business photography, videography, website design and development, local SEO (Google Business Profile setup)
- Photography: on-site, never AI-generated; a half-day shoot delivers 25-40 edited photos in about 5 days
- Pricing (from, final quote after a free listing audit): Google Business Profile setup from €150; Season Refresh (new photos and video) from €450; website from €900; Booking-Ready Launch (shoot, video, 5-8 page website, Google profile) from €2,400; Care & Visibility from €120/month
- Contact: info@horizonvantage.ie, +353 89 493 9050, https://horizonvantage.ie/contact/
- Google Business Profile: https://share.google/URlyVh4JCicbSqVF6
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/horizonvantage

## Who it's for
- [Cafés, bakeries & food producers](https://horizonvantage.ie/food-and-drink/): cafés, bakeries, farm shops, makers and artisan producers
- [Shops, salons & barbershops](https://horizonvantage.ie/photography/): pet shops, barbershops, salons, gyms and independent retailers
- [Stays & experiences](https://horizonvantage.ie/stays-and-experiences/): holiday lets, glamping, B&Bs, guesthouses, activity providers and small venues

## Services
- [Photography](https://horizonvantage.ie/photography/): on-site business photography in Wicklow, shot at your business
- [Videography](https://horizonvantage.ie/videography/): short vertical clips and promo film, shot alongside the photography
- [Website design](https://horizonvantage.ie/web-projects/): fast, custom-built sites designed around real photography
- [Local SEO](https://horizonvantage.ie/local-seo/): Google Business Profile setup and local search
